description.en: Registers one agent tool, `plugin_guard`, that statically scans a plugin package before it is installed. It reports the verdict with reasons such as a missing or broken `dsh.bundle.patch`, an undeclared `dsh.permissions` block, install scripts, dangerous APIs or obfuscation, dependency risk and source-integrity changes. The scan only reads files; it never imports, installs, evaluates or runs the scanned code. Ships no client code.
